title: آليات الترتيب
description: الآليات التي يستخدمها النظام لترتيب عمليات التفتيش والحفاظ على سلامة بياناتها: ما يعنيه كل منها، ونوعها، ومكان تعيينها.

requiredData.title: Required data complete
requiredData.desc: The system makes sure every required question shown in an inspection is answered before it is accepted.
requiredData.sub: Applied by the system itself, with no setting.

validAnswer.title: Valid answer values
validAnswer.desc: An answer must be one of the question's options and within its range.
validAnswer.sub: Applied by the system itself, with no setting.

contextTime.title: Measurement context match: keeping to the inspection time
contextTime.desc: A start period and an end period for the task; when required, carrying it out outside them is refused, otherwise the task shows as late. A public link has an expiry date, after which nothing is taken.
contextTime.sub: On a scheduled task when it is created, on an instant template in «Manage instant tasks» for every instant task created from it, and a public link's expiry date in «Channel links».

contextLocation.title: Measurement context match: keeping to the inspection location
contextLocation.desc: Taken only within a range in metres around the company's location, or around a point set on the map for a public link.
contextLocation.sub: The company's location on a scheduled task and on an instant template, and a set point on a public link in «Channel links».
